cohort: 150 healthy women performing at birth skin-to-skin contact while undergoing elective caesarean section, along with their newborns.
finding: Active warming with warm intravenous fluids significantly reduced neonatal hypothermia, maternal hypothermia, and maternal shivering during the perioperative period.
mod_finding: Administering warm intravenous fluids during caesarean section when skin-to-skin contact is performed at birth is a safe practice with multiple health benefits for both newborns and their mothers.
